description: Returns popular gift ideas in a market: well-priced products that several shops sell, one per category and brand, refreshed hourly, with the cheapest current price and the url of each product's Plendio page. The recipient (mother, dad, a child, ...) and age choose the kind of ideas, a budget in the market's currency keeps them under a price, and the answer says how the request was understood. The ideas are popular picks for the market, not tailored to a person; the occasion is echoed in the answer and does not change the picks.

age.description: The recipient's age in years. Up to 12 gives ideas for children.

budget.description: Highest price per gift, in the market's currency (major units, e.g. 300 means 300 kr.).

market.description: Market: dk, se, de or no. Default: the market of the site you connected to.

occasion.description: The occasion, e.g. birthday or christmas. Echoed in the answer; it does not change the ideas.

recipient.description: Who the gift is for, in any market language or English: mother, dad, wife, a child, grandfather. Free text, up to 60 characters.

name: gift_ideas

price_from.description: Cheapest current price, in major units of currency.

url.description: The product's page on Plendio, listing all its offers.

occasion.description: The occasion as given. Not used to choose ideas.

tab.description: The kind of ideas chosen: all, her, him, kids or budget.

title: Get gift ideas
